newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Coelba to sell 550 mln voting shrs Nov 11.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Coelba to sell 550 mln voting shrs Nov 11.

text.p: A block of 550 million voting shares of Bahia state power firm Companhia de Eletricidade da Bahia (Coelba) will be auctioned for a minimum price of 27.5 million reais ($26.7 million) on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange November 11.

This is the first block of shares to be sold by BNDESpar, the investment arm of Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES), which acquired 135 million reais ($131.1 million) worth of debentures convertible into Coelba shares earlier this year.
The funds from this transaction have gone towards restructuring Coelba ahead of its privatization in the first half of 1998.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
